A typical cycle is easier when you know what to expect
Route Planning for Companion Animals

Safe route planning helps pets travel with less stress and helps travelers prepare with confidence. At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk reviews each journey with care so the path to the skyport feels orderly and calm.

Before departure, check that your carrier, documents, and comfort items are ready together. <<FACT F079>> Keep the travel area quiet during check-in, and watch for signs that your pet needs a pause or reassurance.

If your trip includes a transfer, allow extra attention for movement between gates and vehicles. A familiar blanket, steady handling, and a calm tone can help a pet settle. This is especially useful for cats that prefer routine and a secure space. Lucia Kim and Sofia Larsen have both found that a simple, well-planned sequence makes the process easier for everyone.

If your pet has special needs, tell the desk early so staff can note them before you arrive. For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk before travel.
